page.content:
Monkey King, Great Sage Equal to Heaven, and the pilgrimage's fighter.

How Sun Wukong connects

  • Weapon: Golden cudgel — Wukong fights with the golden cudgel.
  • Faction: Tang pilgrimage — Wukong is the senior disciple of the pilgrimage.
  • Location: Flower–Fruit Mountain — Wukong is born and first crowned on Flower–Fruit Mountain.
  • Event: Revolt against Heaven — Wukong leads the war that earns him the Great Sage title and the fall.
  • Item: Tightening fillet — The fillet is the pain-band that binds Wukong to Sanzang.
  • Character: Jade Emperor — Wukong revolts against the Jade Emperor's court.
  • Character: Buddha — The Buddha wins the wager and pins Wukong under the mountain.

What is Sun Wukong?

Sun Wukong is born of stone, learns seventy-two transformations, raids Heaven, and is pinned under Five Elements Mountain until Sanzang frees him. The golden cudgel and the headband define his service.

Key threads lead to Golden cudgel, Tang pilgrimage, Flower–Fruit Mountain, Revolt against Heaven, Tightening fillet and Jade Emperor.
